description: Refine an approved HLD into a low-level design.
instructions: Refine the approved HLD in input.inputs.hld for the requirements in input.inputs.requirements. Design every service, web/mobile app, gateway and batch component of the HLD (use the HLD component ids), its modules, API operations (HTTP method + path, request/response entity names defined in 'data'), data entities with attributes and relationships, sequences for the main flows (participants are HLD component or actor ids; operations must belong to the step's target component) and the deployment. Every Must requirement must be realised by a component design, API, sequence or decision. Add compliance entries for every mandatory standard. Run design.check with {document, context: {requirements, hld}} before answering and fix every error.
